newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 10.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Security Minister Marcel Dibonan Kone says corrupt policemen must be driven from the force - U.N. High Commissioner for Refugees Sadako Ogata, winner of the Peace Prize named after Ivory Coast's independence president Felix Houphouet-Boigny, to use the 80 million CFA prize money to start a fund to help educate African refugees. - Ivory Coast's prime minister, Daniel Kablan Duncan, visits South Korea at the head of a delegation of Ivorian businessmen - Cement company SICM reports 30.92 increase in turnover in first half of its 1995/96 financial year and 25 percent in the second half (ending September 1996) LA VOIE - Education Minister Pierre Kipre tells teachers who staged strike on December 4 and 5 to leave the profession if they feel they are underpaid. LE JOUR - Opposition allies the Ivorian Popular Front (FPI) and the Rally of the Republicans split over December 29 parliamentary by-election in FPI stronghold of Gagnoa
